summary: Arm whips fast through the cut-in frames with an abrupt snap, and the shot has a hard lighting pop at 28.06; the rest is steady.

faults.what: Right arm swings from raised near the face (25.29) to extended out (25.33) to hanging low with fist by hip (25.39) in about 3 frames. It reads as the cut tweening or a snap into pose, not a settled first frame.
faults.fix: Start the shot already in the hanging pose, or trim the first 6 frames of the mocap so the arm drop happens before the cut.

faults.what: After the fast drop the arms stop almost dead by 25.46–25.53 with no overshoot or settle. The pose snaps and then freezes.
faults.fix: Add a small overshoot and ease into the hanging pose.

faults.what: At 28.03 the scene goes dark. At 28.06 the background jumps to a flat orange-purple gradient and the figure becomes a near-black silhouette. The wall, floor and pillar vanish. This is a one-frame hard swap with no transition, matching the x34 difference spike.
faults.fix: If it is not an intended lighting cut, fix the light or background swap so it fades or cuts cleanly. If intended, make it a real cut with a consistent setup.

faults.what: From 28.06 to 28.23 the silhouette is nearly static with arms hanging in a stiff, symmetrical pose and a blank, dead hold. No weight shift or breathing reads.
faults.fix: Add a subtle weight shift, breath or head move during the hold.
